facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 50°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 29.

facts.text: Snow left Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft) and Skookum Creek (3,320 ft) 10 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: left May 26; earlier seasons: June 23 (2023), June 17 (2024), June 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: left May 5; earlier seasons: May 29 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 10 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the third highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft) and Skookum Creek (3,320 ft).

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: 36.2 in on April 19; earlier seasons: 61.3 in (2023), 38.0 in (2024), 35.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: 23.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 53.3 in (2023), 22.9 in (2024), 26.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 29 and June 30, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Decline Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 18, 218 ft below the pass; points to April 29 to June 14

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out May 26, 1,198 ft below the pass; points to May 16 to July 16

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 5, 1,378 ft below the pass; points to April 27 to June 30
